guides.title: 晶圓表面清洗：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer surface cleaning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「污染分類」建立判讀邊界。粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Classify contaminants to define the interpretation boundary. Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜污染分類：檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜沖洗置換模型：檢查結果是否能支持「僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜潔淨交接單：檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Classify contaminants: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Model rinse displacement: Check whether the evidence supports: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Complete the cleanliness handoff: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沖洗置換模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「潔淨交接單」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model rinse displacement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the cleanliness handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「沖洗置換模型」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for model rinse displacement and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

related.transfer: 清洗效果同時受超純水品質與環境再污染限制。
related.transferEn: Cleaning is limited by ultrapure-water quality and environmental recontamination.
related.difference: 本課驗收重點是去污效果、材料損失、再污染；「超純水供應系統」則以水質多指標、使用點、滯留為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes removal, material loss and recontamination; Ultrapure-water supply systems treats water-quality indicators, points of use and stagnation as a different work package. Shared principles do not justify copying dimensions, materials or acceptance limits.
